name: 63128 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63128 (Saint Louis) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63128 (Saint Louis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 14 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
